researchScope: 15 assigned destinations that had no active media at the start of this web review. Complementary records for the other 7 missing destinations are maintained by the integrating owner.
method: Public web search, primary publisher pages and item-specific image/license metadata; downloaded candidates inspected as local images. No application, development server, browser or tests were launched. Searches returning HTTP 429 were not treated as successful results.
publicationPolicy: Use only actual subject photographs with item/page provenance and applicable reuse permission. Research candidates do not automatically enter the active catalogue. National PR-centre custom terms apply to its website/subdomains only; they do not extend to karakalpakstan.travel or UZA.
